The text above is the NOTICE file of the TradingView/lightweight-charts repository at the tag v5.3.0
(https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts/blob/v5.3.0/NOTICE), copied unchanged; the npm package carries
no NOTICE file of its own.

lightweight-charts-5.3.0.js is dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js from the npm package
lightweight-charts@5.3.0 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/lightweight-charts), unchanged, licensed under the Apache
License 2.0 (lightweight-charts-LICENSE.txt beside it). It incorporates parts of tslib ((c) Microsoft Corporation),
under the BSD Zero Clause License.

The package README asks for this attribution notice and a link to https://www.tradingview.com/ on the page that shows
the chart. The coin page keeps the chart's own TradingView logo (the attributionLogo option, on by default), which
links there, and says under the chart which library draws it, with this notice.
